W.note: Thorough reverse-sear bison rib with honest mammoth sourcing (permafrost meat, lab-grown meatball) and an ice-age table, though it runs long and gets clinical.

X.note: Clean, compact bison reverse sear with an honest opener, but mammoth is barely present beyond the juniper and a stock 'ice age' nod.

Y.note: Most mammoth-literate (Yuka, dogs eating carcasses, Yakutian horse, reindeer swap) with a carve-at-the-table show, but heavy on caveats and sections.

Z.note: Generic pan-seared steak with a one-line mammoth disclaimer and inconsistent oven/timing instructions.
